changes: NEW SKU DWS-AEGIS-PILOT-001 (DWS IQ Aegis Pilot, 3 months): €45,000 one-time. Reference scope carried over from the April 2026 Aegis engagement model.

changes: Three hardware-margin bumps per user direction (capture small reseller margin without undercutting NVIDIA/Acer EU channel):
